en: Black‑and‑white historic view of a large cobbled market square surrounded by multi‑storey 19th‑century townhouses. In the center stands a monument with a statue and landscaped base. People with carts and early automobiles are scattered around the open square, suggesting a market day. Low wooded hills and a church tower rise in the background. Red printed captions at the top read the town name and the word for market square.
